sentences.text: Iain Glen -LRB- born 24 June 1961 -RRB- is a Scottish film , television , and stage actor .	Scottish	United Kingdom

Glen is best known for his roles as Dr. Alexander Isaacs / Tyrant in the Resident Evil films and for portraying Ser Jorah Mormont on Game of Thrones .	Resident Evil	Resident Evil (film series)	Jorah Mormont	Jorah Mormont	Game of Thrones	Game of Thrones
